heroSummary: GGUSD’s 2026–27 school year begins Monday, August 10, 2026, and ends Tuesday, May 25, 2027. The district calendar includes non-student days on October 30 and January 4, Thanksgiving Recess from November 23–27, Winter Recess from December 21–January 1, and Spring Recess from March 15–19.

customSections.label: What Changed From 2025–26?
customSections.content: The 2026–27 calendar shifts slightly earlier than 2025–26. School begins August 10 instead of August 11, Spring Recess runs March 15–19 instead of March 16–20, and the last day moves from May 27 to May 25.

groups.label: October 30 is a districtwide non-student day
items: GGUSD lists Friday, October 30 separately from the longer school recesses.

groups.label: Students do not return on January 4
items: Winter Recess ends January 1, but Monday, January 4 is a separate non-student day. Students return Tuesday, January 5.

groups.label: GGUSD’s Spring Recess is earlier than nearby districts
items: Spring Recess runs March 15–19, earlier than the spring breaks shown for IUSD, LBUSD, and SAUSD below.

groups.label: GGUSD ends the school year earlier than nearby districts
items: The last day is Tuesday, May 25—earlier than SAUSD, IUSD, and LBUSD in the comparison below.

calendarFaqs.q: When does GGUSD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school is Monday, August 10, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is GGUSD Spring Recess in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Recess runs March 15 through March 19, 2027. Students return Monday, March 22.

calendarFaqs.q: What are the GGUSD non-student days in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: GGUSD lists districtwide non-student days on Friday, October 30, 2026, and Monday, January 4, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is GGUSD’s last day of school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Tuesday, May 25, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Does GGUSD publish an official PDF calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: GGUSD publishes these dates on its official calendar webpage. The printable PDF on this page is a MySchoolDates convenience copy, not a district-issued PDF.

GGUSD’s 2025–26 calendar was also reviewed from an official GGUSD source before calculating the year-over-year changes shown above.
GGUSD did not provide an official 2026–27 PDF link; the downloadable PDF on this page is generated by MySchoolDates.
